decisions.reason: Vendor product changelog: weekly Metasploit wrap-up announcing 13 new modules and framework 6.5 features (malleable profiles, MCP, AArch64 shells). No advisory, attack, breach, or new disclosure. The two named CVEs are already covered elsewhere: Fragnesia CVE-2026-46300 is a 3-month-old KEV-listed story with public PoC; CVE-2025-49132 (Pterodactyl Panel RCE) gets only a one-line mention with no vulnerability detail, not enough for a standalone story. Precision over recall.
